subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should resolving this issue require native WebChat parity, or should the first implementation be scoped to complete Control UI coverage?
rationale: Control UI and native WebChat have independent rendering stacks, tests, and real-behavior proof requirements, so this choice determines whether the work is one bounded UI PR or a cross-platform feature.

options.title: Control UI first
options.body: Implement and prove safe linkification across all Control UI tool-output paths, with native WebChat parity tracked separately.

options.title: Require cross-platform parity
options.body: Keep one issue covering both Lit and SwiftUI renderers and require browser plus native proof before resolution.

recommendation.title: Control UI first
recommendation.body: Implement and prove safe linkification across all Control UI tool-output paths, with native WebChat parity tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review explicitly identified this scope decision across both affected surfaces.
